setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step phrase through the test MIDI device: trigs on steps 1 to 4 with C D E F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97. The channel range is steps 1-4, the tempo is the default 90 BPM, Rate is /1 and the sequencer is stopped. Every Mosaic option is at its default, so Shift press to stop is Off. The Device page for CH01 is showing.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press Play/Stop (1,8). The phrase starts and the MIDI stream carries the four notes.
steps.title: Start playback

steps.caption: With Shift press to stop Off, press Play/Stop (1,8) again after under a second. The sequencer stops, the MIDI stream goes silent and every sounding note is released.
steps.title: A tap stops by default

steps.caption: Tap K1 and open PARAMS > MOSAIC, select Shift press to stop and turn E3 right to On. The row reads On.
steps.title: Turn Shift press to stop on

steps.caption: Close the menu and press Play/Stop to start. Starting is never blocked: the phrase plays.
steps.title: Start with the option on

steps.caption: Tap Play/Stop again after under a second. The tap is ignored and the phrase keeps playing.
steps.title: Ignore a short stop tap

steps.caption: Press and hold Play/Stop for 0.9 seconds, then release. This is still shorter than the one-second threshold, so playback continues.
steps.title: Hold briefly without stopping

steps.caption: Hold K1 and tap Play/Stop. With Shift held, a short tap stops playback and releases its notes.
steps.title: Stop with Shift

steps.caption: Tap Play/Stop to start again. Hold K3 and tap Play/Stop: K3 is not a shift key, so playback continues.
steps.title: K3 is not a shift key

steps.caption: Hold Play/Stop alone for 1.1 seconds. Playback stops, because a hold of one second or more counts as a long press.
steps.title: Stop with a long press

steps.caption: Tap K1 and open PARAMS > MOSAIC, select Shift press to stop and turn E3 left to Off. The row reads Off.
steps.title: Turn Shift press to stop off

steps.caption: Close the menu, start playback and tap Play/Stop: a short tap stops it again.
steps.title: Ordinary tap stop is back

title: Protect playback from a stray tap
